items.exampleEn: The sun gives off light and heat.
I didn't love the idea, but I went along with it.
items.exampleZh: 我不是很喜歡這個主意，但還是配合了。

items.exampleEn: Please hand your phone over before the exam starts.
items.exampleZh: 考試開始前，請把手機交出來。

items.exampleEn: She held back her tears during the speech.
The team kept up a fast pace all afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 這支隊伍整個下午都維持很快的速度。

items.exampleEn: Her father was laid off when the shop closed.
items.exampleZh: 那家店關門時，她爸爸被資遣了。

items.exampleEn: The movie didn't live up to our expectations.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影沒有達到我們的期望。

items.sentenceEn: It's not easy to keep up a conversation in English.
items.sentenceZh: 用英文持續聊下去並不容易。

items.audioEn: Our company laid off twenty people last month, so everyone who is left has more work to do now.
items.audioZh: 我們公司上個月資遣了二十個人，所以現在留下來的每個人都有更多工作要做。
items.questionZh: 說話者的公司現在情況如何？
options: Twenty new workers were hired last month
Everyone got a pay raise this year

items.sentenceEn: Please don't hold anything back; tell me the truth.
items.sentenceZh: 請不要隱瞞任何事，告訴我實話。

items.sentenceEn: She worked hard to live up to her parents' hopes.
items.sentenceZh: 她努力達到父母對她的期望。

items.stemEn: Everyone else liked the plan, so I decided to ____ it.
items.stemZh: 其他人都喜歡這個計畫，所以我決定贊同。

items.stemEn: At the end of his shift, the guard ____ the office key to the next guard.
items.stemZh: 值班結束時，警衛把辦公室的鑰匙交給下一位警衛。

items.passageEn: When Mr. Chen opened his coffee shop ten years ago, he hoped it would become a favorite place in the neighborhood. The room is bright, and the kitchen gives off the smell of fresh bread every morning. Business was hard during the first year, but he cared about his staff and never laid them off. Instead, he worked longer hours himself. Now his daughter is ready to take over, and he plans to hand the shop over to her next spring. He says he will miss it, but the shop is a family tradition, and he is happy that she wants to keep it up.
items.passageZh: 陳先生十年前開這家咖啡店時，希望它能成為這一帶大家最喜歡的地方。店裡很明亮，每天早上廚房都飄出新鮮麵包的香味。第一年生意很辛苦，但他很照顧員工，從來沒有資遣他們，而是自己工作更長的時間。現在他的女兒已經準備好接手，他打算明年春天把店交給她。他說他會很捨不得，但這家店是家裡的傳統，他很高興女兒想延續下去。

questions.questionZh: 第一年生意不好時，陳先生怎麼做？
options: 搬到租金比較便宜的地方
請員工減少上班的天數

questions.questionZh: 陳先生明年春天打算做什麼？

items.promptZh: 這台舊冰箱散發出一種奇怪的味道。
referenceEn: This old fridge gives off a strange smell.
This old refrigerator is giving off a strange smell.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「散發」（例如 gives off a strange smell 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 smells strange、has a strange smell 等）
時態可用現在簡單式、現在進行式或現在完成式（例如 gives off、is giving off、has given off 等）

items.promptZh: 雖然不太滿意，大部分員工還是配合了經理的新規定。
referenceEn: Although they weren't very happy, most employees went along with the manager's new rules.
Most of the staff went along with the manager's new rules, even though they weren't happy.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「配合」（例如 went along with the new rules 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 accepted the new rules、followed the new rules、agreed with 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 went along with、have gone along with 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「didn't live up to all the excitement」這個搭配不夠道地：live up to 慣用的受詞是 expectations、the hype、its reputation 等。建議改為 "The movie didn't live up to the hype." 或 "The movie didn't live up to our expectations."（exampleZh 要跟著調整）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：例句改為 "The movie didn't live up to our expectations."（中譯「這部電影沒有達到我們的期望。」）；同課閱讀第一句原為 "hoped it would live up to his customers' hopes"（hope 重複），改為 "hoped it would become a favorite place in the neighborhood"，避免與例句雷同
